cards.name: Distortion
cards.summary: Amp-style audio distortion (drive, gain, wet/dry mix, output volume) plus a Bitcrusher that lowers bit depth and sample rate for crunchy lo-fi / 8-bit sound.
use_for: megaphone / loudspeaker voice on a short satirical quote or rally clip
crunchy lo-fi hit under a glitch transition
'hacked signal' / corrupted audio under a glitch title
gritty bass hit or riser in a trailer
avoid: High Drive + Gain clips hard and gets painfully loud: keep Volume low and check the meter
On a whole narration track it destroys intelligibility; use on short accents only

params.name: Type
params.does: distortion / amp character (1-based popup: 1 Soft Clip, 2 Hard Clip, 3 Saturation 1, 4 Saturation 2, 5 Tube, 6 Fuzz)

params.name: Gain
params.does: signal level pushed into the distortion stage

cards.scripting: Audio effect: only applies to layers that carry audio and changes nothing visible, so status is needs_input (the visual gallery skips it); the effect itself is current. Property names are flat: 'Amp' and 'Bitcrusher' are header rows, not path groups, so use 'Drive', 'Resolution (bit)' etc. Type is a 1-based popup: 1 Soft Clip (default), 2 Hard Clip, 3 Saturation 1, 4 Saturation 2, 5 Tube, 6 Fuzz (read from After Effects 26.0). The Amp stage is ACTIVE at defaults (Drive 25, Mix 100), so the effect colours the sound as soon as it is applied; the Bitcrusher stage is neutral at Resolution 24 + Downsample 1. Newer AE audio effect missing from older Adobe docs: behaviour is inferred from property names (low confidence), verify by ear and on the audio meter.

verified.note: Audio effect with status needs_input: it changes nothing visible, so the AE gallery has no frame for it.

cards.name: Flange & Chorus
cards.summary: Mixes delayed, pitch-modulated copies of the audio with the original: short delays give a swooshing jet-like flange, longer delays with several voices give a thick chorus.
use_for: sci-fi / robot / 'AI voice' treatment on a short line
swirly whoosh on a transition SFX
thicken a thin music sting or riser
dream / flashback treatment on a music bed
avoid: On narration it sounds underwater and robotic; keep to SFX, music or deliberate character voices
Dry Out + Wet Out can each go to 400%: high values clip

params.name: Voice Separation Time (ms)
params.does: delay between voices: short = flange, long = chorus

params.name: Modulation Rate
params.does: LFO speed of the sweep in Hz

cards.scripting: Audio effect: needs a layer with audio, nothing visible (status needs_input only so the visual gallery skips it). Invert Phase and Stereo Voices are 0/1 numbers. Defaults (3 ms, 1 voice) are a flange; switch to chorus by raising Voice Separation Time to ~25 and Voices to 3.

verified.note: Audio effect with status needs_input: it changes nothing visible, so the AE gallery has no frame for it.

cards.name: Gate
cards.summary: Noise gate: silences the audio whenever its level falls below a threshold, with attack, hold and release times controlling how smoothly it opens and closes.
use_for: mute fan / room hiss in the pauses between narration phrases
cut mic bleed between answers in an interview
chop reverb tails off hits and drums for punchy social edits
clean silence under a voice before adding music
avoid: Threshold too high chops the starts and ends of words
Short Release on noisy audio causes audible chattering/pumping
It does not remove noise under the speech itself

params.name: Threshold (dB)
params.does: level below which the gate closes; default -60 is effectively always open

params.name: Attack (ms)
params.does: how fast the gate opens when sound returns

params.name: Hold (ms)
params.does: how long it stays open after the level drops

cards.scripting: Audio effect: needs a layer with audio, nothing visible (status needs_input). With the default Threshold of -60 dB it does almost nothing; always set Threshold. Newer AE audio effect missing from older Adobe docs; semantics inferred from standard noise-gate controls. Premiere's closest is the AutoGate section of its 'Dynamics' audio effect.

verified.note: Audio effect with status needs_input: it changes nothing visible, so the AE gallery has no frame for it.

cards.name: High-Low Pass
cards.summary: Single filter that removes frequencies below (High Pass) or above (Low Pass) a cutoff: makes audio thin and telephone-like or muffled and distant.
use_for: muffled 'heard through a wall' / flashback audio that opens up on a cut (Low Pass sweep)
phone-call or radio voice for a quoted statement (High Pass ~400 Hz)
remove wind / traffic rumble from field audio (High Pass 80-120 Hz)
roll off a music bed's highs (Low Pass 3000-5000 Hz) so narration sits on top
avoid: One instance is one filter: a true telephone band needs two instances (High Pass + Low Pass)
Low Pass under ~300 Hz makes speech unintelligible

params.name: Cutoff Frequency
params.typical: Low Pass 400-800 muffled; High Pass 80-120 cleanup, 300-500 telephone

cards.scripting: Audio effect: needs a layer with audio, nothing visible (status needs_input). The default Filter Options is 1 = High Pass, so always set Filter Options explicitly (2 for a muffle / Low Pass sweep) before keyframing Cutoff Frequency. Premiere splits this into separate 'Lowpass' and 'Highpass' effects.

verified.note: Audio effect with status needs_input: it changes nothing visible, so the AE gallery has no frame for it.

cards.name: Modulator
cards.summary: Adds vibrato (pitch wobble) and tremolo (volume wobble) by modulating the audio with a sine or triangle LFO; high rates give a ring-mod robot tone.
use_for: robot / alien / 'AI' character voice (high Modulation Rate)
warbly old-tape wobble on music under archival footage
dreamy tremolo on a flashback music bed
alarm / siren wobble on a tone
avoid: High Modulation Depth on dialogue sounds seasick and cheap
Tremolo rate that fights the music tempo sounds wrong

params.name: Modulation Type
params.does: LFO waveform: smooth sine or sharper triangle

cards.scripting: Audio effect: needs a layer with audio, nothing visible (status needs_input). Defaults already wobble the sound (10 Hz, Amplitude Modulation 50). Modulation Type: 1 Sine, 2 Triangle (read from After Effects 26.0). No direct Premiere equivalent.

verified.note: Audio effect with status needs_input: it changes nothing visible, so the AE gallery has no frame for it.

cards.name: Parametric EQ
cards.summary: Three-band parametric equalizer: boosts or cuts a chosen frequency band per band (centre frequency, bandwidth, boost/cut) to shape the tone of voice or music.
use_for: clean narration: cut rumble ~100 Hz and boost presence 3-5 kHz
carve space in the music bed at 2-4 kHz under VO
tame harsh sibilance around 6-8 kHz
narrow-band telephone / walkie-talkie voice
avoid: Big boosts clip and sound honky; prefer cuts
Defaults are not neutral per the harvest (band 1 on with Boost/Cut 50 at 1 kHz; bands 2-3 also default to 50): always set Boost/Cut explicitly and leave bands 2-3 off unless their gain is set too

params.name: Boost/Cut
params.does: band 1 gain; negative cuts, positive boosts

params.name: Band 2 Enabled
params.does: turns band 2 on (off by default; its default gain is 50 at 5 kHz, so enable it only when Boost/Cut#2 is set too)

params.name: Frequency#2
params.does: band 2 centre frequency (Hz); not reachable by name through the AE spec today, see scripting

params.name: Boost/Cut#2
params.does: band 2 gain; not reachable by name through the AE spec today, see scripting

params.name: Band 3 Enabled
params.does: turns band 3 on (off by default; default gain 50 at 10 kHz)

params.name: Frequency#3
params.does: band 3 centre frequency (Hz); not reachable by name through the AE spec today, see scripting

cards.scripting: Audio effect: needs a layer with audio, nothing visible (status needs_input). Band properties repeat their names (bands 1-3 each have 'Frequency', 'Bandwidth', 'Boost/Cut'); 'Frequency Response' is a custom graph header, not a group. AdobeBridge's AE setter (ae_lib.jsx dress()) looks properties up by name only and does NOT resolve '#N': plain 'Frequency' / 'Bandwidth' / 'Boost/Cut' reach band 1, while 'Frequency#2' etc. are skipped with a warning. From a spec, use band 1 only (or stack several Parametric EQ instances, one band each); bands 2-3 need a script that addresses them by property index. Boost/Cut units were not harvested (range -100..100, default 50, which looks far from neutral): treat values as roughly dB, start small (+/-6 to 12) and verify by ear.

verified.note: Audio effect with status needs_input: it changes nothing visible, so the AE gallery has no frame for it.

cards.name: Reverb
cards.summary: Simulates a room or hall by adding diffuse reflections and a decaying tail to the audio, from a small room to a long cathedral echo.
use_for: 'voice of history' / flashback quote with a hall tail
reverb throw on the last word or hit before a cut to black in a trailer
match a dry VO to a big rally / hall shot
make a whoosh or stinger feel bigger
avoid: On full narration it muddies intelligibility; keep Wet low
The tail stops at the layer's out point and an audio footage layer cannot run past its source: precompose it (or enable time remapping) and extend the layer so the tail can ring out
High Wet with high Reverb Time sounds amateur

params.name: Reverb Time (ms)
params.does: average delay between the original sound and its reflections; longer = bigger space

params.name: Decay
params.does: how long the tail takes to die away (%)

cards.scripting: Audio effect: needs a layer with audio, nothing visible (status needs_input). For a reverb throw, keyframe Wet Out up and Dry Out down together; put the audio in a precomp longer than the clip (or time-remap and extend it) so the tail is not cut at the source's last frame.

verified.note: Audio effect with status needs_input: it changes nothing visible, so the AE gallery has no frame for it.

cards.name: Stereo Mixer
cards.summary: Sets the volume and pan position of the left and right channels independently, for balancing, mono fixes and left-right pans.
use_for: fix a one-sided interview mic: Left Pan 0 and Right Pan 0 to centre it
pan a whoosh left-to-right to follow on-screen motion
narrow a wide music bed under narration
rebalance a louder channel
avoid: Invert Phase on a source that is later summed to mono can cancel it on phone speakers
Hard pans on dialogue feel wrong on headphones

params.name: Left Pan
params.does: where the left channel sits, -100 left to 100 right

params.name: Right Pan
params.does: where the right channel sits, -100 left to 100 right

cards.scripting: Audio effect: needs a layer with audio, nothing visible (status needs_input). To pan the whole sound, keyframe Left Pan and Right Pan together. Invert Phase is a 0/1 number.

verified.note: Audio effect with status needs_input: it changes nothing visible, so the AE gallery has no frame for it.

cards.name: Tone
cards.summary: Synthesizes simple tones (up to five frequencies mixed as a chord) on the layer's audio: beeps, bleeps, hums and alarms.
use_for: censor bleep over a cut profanity in a political or news clip
countdown / timer beeps in an explainer
flatline, alarm or sci-fi hum sound design in a trailer
UI blips on on-screen text pops
avoid: Defaults play a 5-note chord (A, B, C#, D, E), not a single beep: zero Frequency 2-5
Level near 100 is harsh and loud; keep 15-30
Hard on/off without a short ramp can click

params.name: Waveform options
params.does: tone waveform (1-based popup: 1 Sine (default), 2 Triangle, 3 Saw, 4 Square, 5 White Noise)

params.name: Frequency 2
params.does: second tone in Hz; 0 to silence

params.name: Frequency 3
params.does: third tone in Hz; 0 to silence

params.name: Frequency 4
params.does: fourth tone in Hz; 0 to silence

params.name: Frequency 5
params.does: fifth tone in Hz; 0 to silence

cards.scripting: Generates audio, so it needs an audio-capable layer (AE greys audio effects out on layers without audio; a short silent audio clip is the safe host) and shows nothing visible (status needs_input). Put bleeps on their own layer: the tone may replace or mask the host's audio (unverified). For a single pure tone set Frequency 2-5 to 0. Waveform options: 1 Sine, 2 Triangle, 3 Saw, 4 Square, 5 White Noise (read from After Effects 26.0). Premiere has no Tone effect: use a bleep SFX file or New Item > Bars and Tone.

verified.note: Audio effect with status needs_input: it changes nothing visible, so the AE gallery has no frame for it.

cards.name: Bilateral Blur
cards.summary: Edge-preserving blur: smooths areas of similar colour while keeping strong edges sharp, giving smoother skin, cleaner noise or a flat painterly look.
use_for: soften skin on talking-head close-ups (low Radius, masked to the face)
clean blocky or noisy compressed archival / phone footage before grading
painterly 'memory' look on documentary stills
flatten background detail behind text while keeping silhouettes
avoid: Render time grows fast with Radius: keep under ~30 at 1080p (range goes to 30000)
High Threshold on faces gives waxy, plastic skin

params.name: Radius
params.does: reach of the blur in pixels

params.name: Threshold
params.does: how different neighbouring pixels may be and still blur together; higher = more smoothing across edges

cards.scripting: Colorize is a 0/1 checkbox; Adobe documents unchecked as producing a grayscale-like result (unverified), so keep 1. Radius is in layer pixels, so scale it with resolution. No direct Premiere equivalent (no edge-preserving blur there).

verified.note: Faces, stripes and background are smoothed into flat painterly areas while foreground-block, stripe and figure edges stay fairly crisp, as the card describes.

cards.name: CC Cross Blur
cards.summary: Blurs the image separately horizontally and vertically and combines the two passes with a chosen transfer mode, giving soft directional or cross-shaped streaky blur.
use_for: horizontal smear transition between shots (Radius X up then down across the cut)
soft dreamy background behind lower-thirds and titles
horizontal light streaks on night rally lights for a trailer look (needs an additive Transfer Mode, check it in the app)
streaky motion smear on a whip-pan or fast push cut
avoid: Equal Radius X and Y looks like a cheap box blur; use Gaussian Blur or Camera Lens Blur for plain defocus
With Repeat Edge Pixels off the frame edges darken or go transparent

params.name: Transfer Mode
params.does: how the horizontal and vertical passes combine (1-based popup of 6, default 1)

params.name: Repeat Edge Pixels
params.does: 0/1: extend edge pixels so borders do not darken

cards.scripting: Transfer Mode is a 1-based popup: 1 Blend, 2 Add, 3 Screen, 4 Multiply, 5 Lighten, 6 Darken (read from After Effects 26.0). Repeat Edge Pixels is a 0/1 number.

verified.note: Soft blur with a clearly stronger horizontal smear (vertical stripes and faces streak sideways) than vertical, matching Radius X 60 / Y 25.

cards.name: CC Radial Blur
cards.summary: Radial blur around a centre point. Type picks the style: 1 Straight Zoom, 2 Fading Zoom and 3 Centered Zoom streak toward or away from the centre, 5 Rotate, 6 Scratch (the default, frame-verified: a rotational spin smear) and 7 Rotate Fading turn around it.
use_for: spin / whip-rotate transition: Type 6, Amount 0 to 40 and back across a cut (at 40 the frame is fully smeared)
short vortex / dizzy hit on a shocking claim or reveal (Type 6, Amount 5-15, 4-12 frames)
zoom-punch transition or rush toward a title card: Type 1 (Straight Zoom) or 2 (Fading Zoom) with Amount keyed 0 -> 40 -> 0 (the zoom Types are known by name, not yet render-checked)
avoid: Type 6 at Amount 40 already destroys the image completely: use 5-15 for a readable spin
Corners darken or go transparent because the spin samples outside the layer: scale the layer up or use a full-frame plate
Held for long it looks dated and cheap: keep it to 4-12 frames
Low Quality at high Amount shows stepped ghost copies

params.name: Type
params.does: blur style (1-based popup): 1 Straight Zoom, 2 Fading Zoom, 3 Centered Zoom, 4 a separator, 5 Rotate, 6 Scratch (default; renders as a rotational spin, frame-verified), 7 Rotate Fading
params.typical: 6 (Scratch) for the spin smear; 1 or 2 for a zoom punch

params.name: Amount
params.does: blur strength; the sign flips the direction (spin direction, or in/out on zoom types)
params.typical: 5-15 readable spin, 30-60 full smear at a transition peak

params.name: Quality
params.does: sample count: higher is smoother and slower

params.name: Center
params.does: origin of the zoom/spin in layer pixels

cards.equivalent: Zoom Blur (Premiere transition, not an effect)
cards.scripting: Center is a point in layer pixels ([960, 540] = centre of a 1920x1080 layer). Frame-verified: Type 6 (Scratch, the harvested default) renders a ROTATIONAL spin blur, not a zoom, and Amount 40 on it smears the whole frame into concentric rings with dark corners. The Type menu (read from After Effects 26.0): 1 Straight Zoom, 2 Fading Zoom, 3 Centered Zoom, 4 a separator (never set it), 5 Rotate, 6 Scratch, 7 Rotate Fading; only Type 6 has been rendered, so the zoom looks are known by their names, not yet by a frame. Amount 0 (the harvested default) means no blur, so keyframe it for transitions. Premiere 2026 has no radial-blur EFFECT; its 'Zoom Blur' and 'Radial Blur' transitions (and 'Cross Zoom') are the closest stand-ins on a cut.

verified.note: Type 6 at Amount 40 turns the frame into concentric spin rings around the centre with dark corners; the picture is unrecognisable, as the corrected text says.
